about: Bucha: cottages, new complexes and houses in the forest

In Bucha a private house in the forest stands next to low-rise complexes and townhouses. Many families move here from Kyiv for quiet and space, so the typical request is a home that works for everyday life: a study for working from home, walk-in wardrobes, a pantry, a terrace.

A large part of Bucha's housing was rebuilt or built anew after 2022. For these houses we plan modern systems — heating, ventilation, backup power — together with the interior from the start, not afterwards.

In Bucha cottages a designer typically joins a large living room with the kitchen, adds a fireplace or a second lighting zone, and plans an entrance with room for seasonal clothes. In complex apartments — maximum storage and light on a small area. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments, townhouses and houses, from rough works to finishing, including [bathroom](/en/bathroom-renovation) and [kitchen](/en/kitchen-renovation) renovation separately. Plots in Bucha are mostly sandy and wooded: the foundation is designed after the site survey, and we also do [landscape design](/en/landscape-design) from $50 per 100 m².

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: How much does renovation in Bucha cost?
From $550 per m² for works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are separate, per estimate.
Can I order only a design project?
Yes, from $30 per m², minimum $2,500. The drawings work for any contractor; designer supervision can be added separately.
Do you build houses in Bucha and the surrounding area?
Yes: architectural design from $12 per m², shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m².
How can I follow the works from another city or from abroad?
Photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 for an extra fee.
